units.text: Three 10-week sessions run each year for JrK–grade 8, plus private music lessons. The 22 classes below are the most recent published catalog, **9 March to 22 May 2026** — recovered from the school’s own session brochure. Fees are shown per class and per session. Note that Beyond the Bell is a **separate purchase from ASP**: a 3:00–4:00 class does not cover you to 6:00.
The dismissal times below are current and live. The program hours are recovered from a 2020 archive of a page that no longer exists, and they no longer line up with the current bell schedule.
7:15–7:40 a.m., staffed by full-time Davidson Day teachers at a **7:1** ratio — from the 2020 archive, unconfirmed for 2026-27

The archived After School Care window of **2:45–6:00 p.m. for TT–8** comes from a capture dated **18 May 2020 — six years old**. It no longer matches the current schedule: 2:45 p.m. is now only the Early Preschool–JK dismissal, while K–4 dismisses at 3:05 and grades 5–8 at 3:25. Whether older students are covered from their own dismissal is unknown.
The program describes itself as "a safe, engaging, and nurturing environment for supervised play and homework completion" — in words captured from a page that no longer exists.
Every quotation above comes from an archived capture dated **May 2020**. The live site carries no program description at all, so none of it is confirmed for 2026-27 — including the 15:1 ratio.
**No enrichment catalog survives at all** — not a single class name, day or fee is recoverable from any source.

units.text: Families looking at the school cannot see the enrichment catalog. The school advertises "more than 25 after-school enrichment classes". Its examples: music · art · science · chess · karate · cheerleading · field hockey · baseball · volleyball · SAT/ACT prep · coding · drama · robotics. But the class list sits behind the UltraCamp registration portal, so it is not public. No public page gives names with days, grades and fees.
**The enrichment catalog is invisible** to prospective families — behind a portal that currently shows nothing.

The **Extended Care and After School Programs pages have been removed from the live site entirely** — both re-verified as 404 in July 2026, and neither appears in the current site map. A 2026-27 family has no published description of the program at all.

No summer program is published on the live site, and no summer page exists in the site map. An archived 2019 camp page and a third-party aggregator listing exist but neither is confirmed on any school-owned page.
